reason: I already check every receipt myself because I've been burned by double claims, so a bot that flags duplicates in the work chat saves me real hours. Between the café and the scooter repairs I'd use the 30 free ones in a couple of weeks, and $19 is less than one padded receipt.
objection: Will a small new bot still be around in a year? At least the rows sit in my own Google Sheet, so I keep the data if it dies. It catches duplicates, but I doubt it can tell an inflated price or a fake handwritten note from a mechanic I paid in cash, and that's where the cheating happens.
would_change_my_mind: If it misreads the handwritten mechanic notes and local receipts during the free 30, or wants access to my whole Google Drive instead of just one sheet, I don't pay.
